MECA.TITLE: Cases in Which the SRS Airbag & Seat Belt with Pretensioner System Does Not Operate

ITEM.PTXT: Because the front airbag sensors and the G sensor in the center airbag sensor (computer) detect the deceleration in a collision acting from the front of the vehicle, the airbag system may not operate depending on the situation. In addition, even in a frontal collision, the system does not operate if the deceleration does not reach the specified value of the sensors.
